article.headline: Howell paces hot shooting No. 16 Washington women past Washington State 82-54
article.description: — Avery Howell scored 22 points and Sayvia Sellers scored 15 of 20 points in the first half as 16th-ranked Washington beat Washington State 82-54 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Howell paces hot shooting No. 16 Washington women past Washington State 82-54
article.story: PULLMAN, Wash. -- — Avery Howell scored 22 points and Sayvia Sellers scored 15 of 20 points in the first half as 16th-ranked Washington beat Washington State 82-54 on Tuesday night. Tilda Trygger scored 13 points for the Huskies (4-0) who shot better from beyond the 3-point line than inside it. Washington was 30 of 58 (52%) overall including 15 of 26 (58%) from 3-point range. Howell added nine rebounds. Eleonora Villa scored 14 of her 17 points in the first half for Washington State (2-3). Sellers tied it at 6-all with a 3-pointer, Trygger followed with her own 3 and their baskets led to an 11-0 run creating a 14-6 advantage with 1:18 left in the first quarter. The Huskies closed the quarter ahead 18-10. Trygger made a 3 with 3:04 before halftime to give Washington its first double-digit lead at 30-19. The Huskies led 44-26 at intermission. Washington sealed it in the third outscoring the Cougars 26-10. Washington owns the all-time series lead at 44-13. Up next Washington: Hosts Stanford on Friday. Washington State: Faces Kansas on Thanksgiving in the Cancun Challenge in Cancun, Mexico. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
